title: Light-Assisted Rechargeable Lithium Batteries: Organic Molecules for Simultaneous Energy Harvesting and Storage
notes: Spine: need -> single-molecule hypothesis -> TKL base + windowed C-coated mesh architecture -> CVD carbon -> TKL slurry -> lithiate + on/off light -> LiTKL/TKL bonding -> visible absorption (gap 2.67/2.41 eV) -> level alignment -> photo-hole delithiation MEC -> (a) photo-enhanced charging current, (b) competing photocharging MEC -> extra discharge capacity / CE 112% -> conclusion. Side: TKL crystal-like grains, hermetic cell (joining), unchanged discharge voltage -> limitation (light only assists). Audits: o6 HOMO -6.5 (fig) vs -6.4 (text/arithmetic), o9 Li-TKL level absent from F4e though text cites it, o15 slow on/off current kinetics (thermal alternative not addressed), o17 light capacity only matches cycle-1 dark capacity. Packet: F1 is the TOC graphic and F2 a journal cover (no captions, not paper figures); F3-F6 are paper Figs 1-4. F4a crop carries OCR cue 'micrograph' on a UV-vis panel: citation dropped. Supporting-information figures (S1-S8) not in packet.
